data.title: More than $170 million in crypto moves from Bitget wallets to unidentified address
data.summary_raw: The receiving address has made several swaps, but the reason for the Bitget wallet transfers remains unclear.

data.title: Fed proposes reserve limits, capital standards for stablecoin issuers under GENIUS Act
data.summary_raw: The Federal Reserve proposed new measures for stablecoin issuers, including reserve-asset limits and standardized capital requirements.

data.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI keeps board after shareholder protest, loses equity plan vote
data.summary_raw: SkyAI’s board survived a shareholder protest, but its proposed equity pay plan fell by a wide margin.

data.title: ARK Invest brings $1.3 billion venture fund onchain through Securitize
data.summary_raw: ARK Invest is bringing its $1.3B ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX), which holds OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe, onchain via Securitize on Ethereum.
